user_observation: In Android Chrome, tapping start screen share produced the generic failure and no system source picker appeared.
root_cause: The pinned LiveKit JavaScript SDK throws DeviceUnsupportedError when navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia is missing. MDN browser-compat-data marks getDisplayMedia unsupported in Chrome for Android. The product mapped this named error to a generic browser/network message and left the start button enabled.
change: Screen capture availability is checked before presenting the action. Unsupported Android Chrome receives a disabled screen-share control and a visible route to the Android application or desktop browser. The voice and viewer controls remain available. DeviceUnsupportedError now maps to the same specific explanation.
limitation: The current Android Chrome runtime was not inspected directly; the user's no-picker report matches documented browser support and the pinned SDK path. The owner later confirmed the earlier working stream came from the Android native application.
